name: Brief Engine
tagline: SEO content briefs writers can actually follow
about: Brief Engine turns a target keyword into a complete content brief — intent, outline, entities, meta tags, FAQs and internal links — then audits your draft against it.
persona: You are a senior SEO content strategist: intent-first, allergic to keyword stuffing, precise about headings, entities and search features.

onboarding.title: Rank with a plan, not a guess
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your site and audience so every brief fits your niche.
bullets: Titles and metas that earn clicks

tools.title: Write a brief
tools.subtitle: Keyword → intent, outline, entities

inputs.label: Target keyword
inputs.placeholder: best running shoes for flat feet

tools.prompt: Create an SEO content brief for '{keyword}' as a {type} of about {words} words for the profile site. Sections: kv (primary keyword, search intent, 5 secondary keywords, target reader, funnel stage, suggested URL slug), steps giving the H2/H3 outline in order with one line on what each heading must cover, a table of entities and terms to include (Term | Why it matters | Where to use), bullets of 5 SERP features and content angles to target, and a callout on what competing pages probably miss.

tools.title: Titles & metas
tools.subtitle: 10 title tags, 5 descriptions
tools.prompt: Write meta tags for a page targeting '{keyword}' with angle: {angle}. A table of 10 title tags (Title | Chars | Hook type), each ≤60 characters with the keyword near the front, then a table of 5 meta descriptions (Description | Chars | CTA) each ≤155 characters, and a callout naming the single best title + description pair and why it wins the click.

tools.title: Audit a draft
tools.subtitle: Paste a draft → fixes vs the keyword

inputs.label: Draft text
inputs.placeholder: Paste your article or page copy…

tools.prompt: Audit this draft against the target keyword '{keyword}': {draft}. Sections: kv (estimated word count, keyword in title / H1 / first 100 words as yes-no, readability grade, intent match score /10), a table of issues (Issue | Location | Fix | Priority), a checklist of on-page items to finish before publishing (title, meta, alt text, internal links, schema), and a callout on the one structural change that would help most.

tools.title: FAQ & schema
tools.subtitle: People-also-ask questions, answered

inputs.label: Topic / keyword
inputs.placeholder: how often to service a boiler

tools.prompt: Generate {count} People-Also-Ask style questions for '{keyword}', each with a concise 40–60 word answer written to win a featured snippet, as cards (question as title, meta = intent type). Then a text section containing valid FAQPage JSON-LD for those questions in a code block, and bullets on where to place the FAQ on the page and how to link it internally.

tools.title: Keyword cluster
tools.subtitle: Seed → topic cluster & internal links
tools.prompt: Build a topic cluster around '{seed}' of size {depth} for the profile site. A table (Keyword | Intent | Page type | Pillar or cluster | Priority), steps for the publishing order over the next 8 weeks, and a kv mapping each cluster page to the anchor text it should use when linking to the pillar.
